facts.fact: DHIS2.org reports that integration of the iCHIS community NCD module with the MaHIS OpenMRS-based electronic medical record system at health facilities was being finalised as of April 2026 and expected complete in the near term; once live, community health workers and facility staff would share information across the care pathway for the first time.

systems.owner: Ministry of Health, Community Health Services section; technical implementation by HISP UNIMA
systems.tiers: community health workers across the country, deployed October 2021; NCD module piloted in Salima District, 50 CHWs trained 8-9 April 2026
not stated; in use since around 2000

note: Most of the Malawi content concerns iCHIS, a community system; DHIS2 is named as the national platform in use since around 2000 without a description of aggregate reporting, so it is left unclassified. The pending iCHIS-MaHIS integration bears on the community integrated flag: not yet live as of April 2026.
